 ORDER Called again in the afternoon.
2. None appears for the appellant either physically or through Video Conference.
3. A perusal of the order sheet would go to show that inspite of granting sufficient opportunity for seven times, the appellant has not complied the office objections.
Matter is being listed to comply the office objections for which, the appellant has not evinced interest to comply the same inspite of granting sufficient adjournments and pass overs.
No reasons are forthcoming for non- appearance.
Hence, the Appeal stands dismissed for non- prosecution as well as for non-compliance of office objections.
